fullText.simplified:
第二十二章、神秘礼盒

    这第二封信是梅三三给柳雪迟的回信。
    柳雪迟：
    其实我早就注意到你了，你总是站在阳台上看我，但却从来不跟我说话。
    记得最早的一次，你在你的三楼阳台，拿了几张扑克牌，试图飞到我的窗口来。但是你飞得不太行，有几张飞得太近，掉在你家楼下的草地上。又有几张飞得太远，被风一吹，竟然吹进了隔壁的三十三号房。我只看到了扑克牌的一面是红心三点，不太明白你想表达的意思，你是想说我的名字吗？
    最近三十三号房一直都是空的，那里的信箱也坏了，不用钥匙打开。以后如果你要给我写信，还是放在三十三号房门口的信箱里吧，就跟这次一样！
    明天下午三点，我会去华龙路的公园等你，我也有很多话跟你说。我们不见不散！
    梅三三

    “所以……这两个孩子互相喜欢，他们想谈恋爱。”孙林恍然大悟道。虽然他早就猜到了阳台上的展品是想给梅三三看的，但却没明白这里面真正的含义。
    “季平先生，您是怎么知道的？”孙林追问道。
    “还记得那串数字吗？5A33、5A3399、K433……”季平反问道。
    “让我猜猜，让我猜猜。”孙林眯着眼睛，认真地琢磨了起来，“这信里说了，A33的意思是爱三三，那这么猜下去的话……5A33，我爱三三。5A3399，我爱三三久久。K433……K433是什么？”孙林挠了挠头。
    “K433，Kiss三三。”季平先生无奈地摇了摇头。
    “这……这也太可爱了吧，哈哈哈，这就是孩子之间的爱情吧。”孙林大笑了起来。
    突然，孙林好像又意识到了什么，笑眯眯地问道：“季平先生您早就猜到这些数字的含义了？您是怎么猜到的呀？”
    “可能因为我是季平吧。”季平也笑了。
    “后面的，我就都知道了。您知道了两个孩子当天下午三点去华龙路公园，所以您就找到了他们。您好好接待了他们几天，让他们吃好玩好，也给两个孩子时间谈情说爱。他们回家后，自然不愿意跟家人承认，自己消失了几天是去谈恋爱了。他们也不会承认自己亲眼见到了季平，这是他们和崇拜的人之间的小秘密。”孙林一边拿着照片，一边兴致勃勃地说着。
    “季平先生，听说最近有很多穷人收到了神秘礼盒，包括南京旧案当事人的家属。盒子里面是他们急需的钱，盒子上都有一个耳朵的图形，耳朵后面有一块又大又红的印记。大家都在说这是大名鼎鼎的季平做的，不愧是您……”孙林还在滔滔不绝地讲着。
    很安静，没有人回答孙林。
    “季平先生？”孙林转过头，但是旁边空无一人。
    不知道什么时候，季平已经离开了。他的背影消失在了来来往往的人群中，可能他又去查下一个案子了吧……
fullText.traditional:
第二十二章、神秘禮盒

    這第二封信是梅三三給柳雪遲的回信。
    柳雪遲：
    其實我早就注意到你了，你總是站在陽臺上看我，但卻從來不跟我說話。
    記得最早的一次，你在你的三樓陽臺，拿了幾張撲克牌，試圖飛到我的窗口來。但是你飛得不太行，有幾張飛得太近，掉在你家樓下的草地上。又有幾張飛得太遠，被風一吹，竟然吹進了隔壁的三十三號房。我只看到了撲克牌的一面是紅心三點，不太明白你想表達的意思，你是想說我的名字嗎？
    最近三十三號房一直都是空的，那裡的信箱也壞了，不用鑰匙打開。以後如果你要給我寫信，還是放在三十三號房門口的信箱裡吧，就跟這次一樣！
    明天下午三點，我會去華龍路的公園等你，我也有很多話跟你說。我們不見不散！
    梅三三

    “所以……這兩個孩子互相喜歡，他們想談戀愛。”孫林恍然大悟道。雖然他早就猜到了陽臺上的展品是想給梅三三看的，但卻沒明白這裡面真正的含義。
    “季平先生，您是怎麼知道的？”孫林追問道。
    “還記得那串數字嗎？5A33、5A3399、K433……”季平反問道。
    “讓我猜猜，讓我猜猜。”孫林瞇著眼睛，認真地琢磨了起來，“這信裡說了，A33的意思是愛三三，那這麼猜下去的話……5A33，我愛三三。5A3399，我愛三三久久。K433……K433是什麼？”孫林撓了撓頭。
    “K433，Kiss三三。”季平先生無奈地搖了搖頭。
    “這……這也太可愛了吧，哈哈哈，這就是孩子之間的愛情吧。”孫林大笑了起來。
    突然，孫林好像又意識到了什麼，笑眯眯地問道：“季平先生您早就猜到這些數字的含義了？您是怎麼猜到的呀？”
    “可能因為我是季平吧。”季平也笑了。
    “後面的，我就都知道了。您知道了兩個孩子當天下午三點去華龍路公園，所以您就找到了他們。您好好接待了他們幾天，讓他們吃好玩好，也給兩個孩子時間談情說愛。他們回家後，自然不願意跟家人承認，自己消失了幾天是去談戀愛了。他們也不會承認自己親眼見到了季平，這是他們和崇拜的人之間的小秘密。”孫林一邊拿著照片，一邊興致勃勃地說著。
    “季平先生，聽說最近有很多窮人收到了神秘禮盒，包括南京舊案當事人的家屬。盒子裡面是他們急需的錢，盒子上都有一個耳朵的圖形，耳朵後面有一塊又大又紅的印記。大家都在說這是大名鼎鼎的季平做的，不愧是您……”孫林還在滔滔不絕地講著。
    很安靜，沒有人回答孫林。
    “季平先生？”孫林轉過頭，但是旁邊空無一人。
    不知道什麼時候，季平已經離開了。他的背影消失在了來來往往的人群中，可能他又去查下一個案子了吧……

sentences.english: They also wouldn’t admit that they had seen Ji Ping in person. This was a little secret between them and the person they worshiped.”

sentences.traditional: 孫林一邊拿著照片，一邊興致勃勃地說著。

sentences.english: Sun Lin spoke enthusiastically while holding the photos.

sentences.pinyin: jì píng xiān sheng tīng shuō zuì jìn yǒu hěn duō qióng rén shōu dào le shén mì lǐ hé

sentences.english: .. including the families of those involved in the old Nanjing case.

sentence_translations: Chapter 22: Mysterious Gift Boxes
This second letter was a reply from Mei Sansan to Liu Xuechi.
Liu Xuechi:
Actually, I noticed you a long time ago. You’re always standing on the balcony watching me, but you’ve never talked to me.
I remember the first time. You were on your third-floor balcony, holding a few playing cards, trying to make them fly to my window.
But you weren’t very good at making them fly. Several of them didn’t fly far enough and fell on the lawn below your house.
Several of them flew too far, and the wind actually blew them into the house at number thirty-three next door.
I only saw that one side of the playing card was the three of hearts.
I didn’t quite understand what you wanted to express. Were you trying to say my name?
The house at number thirty-three has been vacant recently, and its mailbox is broken, so it can be opened without a key.
If you want to write to me in the future, just put it in the mailbox by the door of the house at number thirty-three, just like this time!
I will meet you at the park on Hualong Road at three o’clock tomorrow afternoon. I also have a lot to tell you.
See you there!
Mei Sansan
“So … these two kids like each other! They want to date,” realized Sun Lin suddenly.
Although he had guessed long ago that the exhibits on the balcony were intended for Mei Sansan to see, ..
.. he had not understood the true meaning behind them.
“Mr. Ji Ping, how did you know?” asked Sun Lin further.
“Do you still remember that string of numbers? 5A33, 5A3399, K433 …” asked Ji Ping in response.
“Let me guess, let me guess,” Sun Lin squinted his eyes, thinking seriously.
“The letter says that A33 means ‘love Sansan’, so if we continue guessing like this …
5A33: ‘I love Sansan’. 5A3399: ‘I love Sansan forever’. K433 … What is K433?” Sun Lin scratched his head.
“K433: ‘kiss Sansan’.” Mr. Ji Ping shook his head helplessly.
“This … this is just too cute! Haha, this must be love between those kids,” Sun Lin burst into laughter.
Suddenly, Sun Lin seemed to realize something and asked with a smile, ..
.. “Mr. Ji Ping, did you guess the meaning of these numbers long ago? How did you guess?”
“Maybe it’s because I’m Ji Ping.” Ji Ping also smiled.
“I know about everything that happened afterwards.
You knew that the two kids were going to Hualong Road park at three o’clock in the afternoon that day, so you found them.
You took good care of them for a few days, making sure they ate well and had a great time, ..
.. and also gave the young couple the time to develop their romance.
After they returned home, ..
.. they naturally didn’t want to admit to their families that they had disappeared for a few days to pursue a romance.
They also wouldn’t admit that they had seen Ji Ping in person. This was a little secret between them and the person they worshiped.”
Sun Lin spoke enthusiastically while holding the photos.
“Mr. Ji Ping, I heard that recently many poor people have received mysterious gift boxes, ..
.. including the families of those involved in the old Nanjing case.
Inside the boxes is the money they desperately need, and each box has an image of an ear with a large, red mark behind it.
Everyone is saying that this is the work of the famous Ji Ping. It’s truly worthy of you …” Sun Lin continued to speak enthusiastically.
It was very quiet. No one answered Sun Lin.
“Mr. Ji Ping?” Sun Lin turned his head, but there was no one beside him.
At some point, Ji Ping had already left.
His figure disappeared into the bustling crowd, perhaps off to investigate the next case …
